description: Zonnepanelen en groene daken 2022 Den Haag is a dataset listed in den-haag-opendata open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by den-haag-opendata. Beschrijving: De zonnepanelen en groene daken in Den Haag in 2022 Bron: NEO Beperkingen: Deze dataset is niet geschikt voor juridische of landmeetkundige doeleinden Mogelijkheden: Deze dataset is geschikt voor het inzichtelijk maken van de locatie op de kaart Coördinatenstelsel: RDnew. De KML is WGS84. Een van de shapefiles ook. Coverage: The Hague. The portal files it under Nature and environment. The portal shows 18,573 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-den-haag-opendata-portal.
